title: Roads open the forest from the inside
dek: Under cloud, a standing forest and a cleared one can look alike from orbit. L-band radar tells them apart, and shows where new roads and clearings spread between two passes.

radar.explainer: NISAR's L-band radar has a wavelength of about 24 cm. It passes between leaves and bounces off branches and trunks, and that scattering returns strongly in the cross-polarized HV channel. Bare ground and pasture return far less HV, so a drop in HV marks canopy that is gone.

legend.label: Yellow-green
legend.meaning: Standing forest. Branches and leaves scatter the radar in every direction, so the cross-polarized HV channel is strong.

legend.label: Slate grey
legend.meaning: Cleared ground. Bare soil and pasture return much less HV.

legend.label: Indigo
legend.meaning: Rivers and open water. They reflect the radar away, so very little returns.

legend.label: Tan
legend.meaning: Roads and cleared land in visible light.

legend.label: HV drop
legend.meaning: How many decibels the HV signal fell between the two windows. Only pixels with a clear drop from forest are drawn.

beats.headline: A forest seen from above
beats.body: This stretch of Rondônia sits in the Amazon's arc of deforestation, where branch roads leave a main road like the bones of a fish.

beats.headline: Radar reads structure, not color
beats.body: An optical image records the light that ground reflects. NISAR sends its own signal, passes through cloud and smoke, and measures how much returns from branches, trunks and bare soil.

beats.headline: The fishbone spreads
beats.body: The same ground, before and after. Where new clearings opened, the HV signal fell by {stat:hv_drop_db} on average.

beats.headline: Hectares, not impressions
beats.body: Pixels whose HV fell past the threshold add up to {stat:cleared_ha} of new clearing between the two windows, across {stat:n_dates} radar dates.

beats.headline: Keep the canopy standing
beats.body: Radar shows where clearing starts. Keeping forest standing depends on land protection and on the communities who live in it. Two organizations work on that in the Amazon.

landmarks.label: Largest new clearing
landmarks.note: Forest here in July was open ground by September. The radar's HV echo, which comes from branches and trunks, fell with it.

landmarks.label: Standing forest
landmarks.note: Intact canopy about six kilometres from the clearing. Its echo stayed steady across every radar pass.

action.headline: Protect the forest behind the roads
action.body: This analysis mapped {stat:cleared_ha} of new clearing in the study area. These organizations protect Amazon forest and the people who live in it.

local.headline: Act where you live
local.body: Most forest cleared in Rondônia becomes cattle pasture. What you buy and who you vote for reach this far.
steps: Ask the shops you use where their beef, leather and soy come from, and whether they track deforestation in their supply chains.
Support organizations that defend Indigenous land rights in the Amazon.
Share this chapter: the radar shows what clouds hide.

cleared_ha.label: Forest cleared
cleared_ha.method: Area of the loss mask. NISAR NISAR_L2_GCOV_PROVISIONAL_V1, 3 dB HV drop from forest, 1 ha minimum patch.

hv_drop_db.label: HV drop inside the mask
hv_drop_db.method: Mean HV of the before composite minus the after composite inside the mask.

hv_before_db.label: HV before
hv_before_db.method: Median composite of the before window.

hv_after_db.label: HV after
hv_after_db.method: Median composite of the after window.
